basis: Pinned shadcn Base UI wrapper + Base UI 1.9.0 primitive implementation/types.
name: Button uses native non-hidden text; icon-only buttons use aria-label/labelledby. Custom checkbox/switch span roots require the primitive-generated or explicitly associated label relation. Input uses native label-for.
keyboard: Native button: Enter/Space activate; checkbox: Space toggles, Enter does not toggle (it may submit its containing form); switch: source useButton Space/Enter activation; input: native text editing and IME. Tab follows native order; disabled controls are skipped unless Button focusableWhenDisabled is explicitly chosen.
disabled: Ignore activation; readonly checkbox/switch/input preserve value. Disabled/readOnly are distinct.
errors: Parent/Field supplies aria-invalid and aria-describedby for error text. The wrapper does not invent validation rules.
adapter: For Base UI 1.9 checkbox/switch default roots are span role controls plus a hidden native form input, not a visible native input or button. The HTML is a semantic projection of that structure.

control.description: Native source action button; base CVA class survives render-prop composition.

icon.description: Optional caller icon, supplementary to an accessible action name.
